patch_description: Add a second refinement pass using COBYLA on a penalized objective for each lattice candidate, keeping whichever result (SLSQP or COBYLA) gives the higher repaired sum. COBYLA's derivative-free, trust-region approach often escapes the local optima where SLSQP stalls, and starting it from the SLSQP output (a warm start) lets it explore the constraint boundary differently. Every output still goes through `_repair`, so feasibility is guaranteed. This is the highest-leverage untested axis within the proven framework (refinement method dominates score spread 2.42→2.61), and it adds only modest extra runtime.
